subject: Decision path & security gating — next steps for Finex pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@finex.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@finex.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + procurement/security heads-up

Evelyn / Ben / Kimberly —

Thanks for the demo earlier — short recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can get procurement and security lined up:

- Decision makers identified on our side: Sara Patel (CFO) will own economic sign-off; Tom Huang (Head, SecOps) will run security review; procurement will be handled by procure@finex.com.
- Our immediate ask: a one-pager for our internal champion (Sara requested ROI bullets and likely cost/bracketing), and a draft mutual action plan that shows timeline to procurement contract and security artifacts.
- We also attached the RFP brief you asked for (Finex_RFP_Attach.pdf).

Next steps from Finex: I will introduce Tom and procurement on this thread if that helps; Sara is out Tue-Thu but will read the MAP.

High level timeline target from our execs: pilot decision by end of August (preferably earlier).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15 if you want to align on the MAP items.

— Liam
Liam O'Connell
Head of Data Platforms, Finex Capital
liam.oconnell@finex.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@finex.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@finex.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick recap + procurement/security heads-up

Thanks Liam — good signal. Looping in Karthik to scope security artifacts and Kim for CS handoff. Ben / I will draft a MAP and a champion-facing one-pager with ROI bullets.

Stakeholder map (working):
- Economic buyer: Sara Patel — CFO (primary approver for pilot and renewal).
- Champion / technical sponsor: Liam O'Connell — owns platform integration and success metrics.
- Security reviewer: Tom Huang — SecOps (needs SOC2, architecture diagram, data flow).
- Procurement: procure@finex.com — standard T&Cs; likely a PO or SOW + DS signature.

Champion enablement (one-pager highlights we'll share):
- Executive ROI headline: 20–30% reduction in inference unit cost on long-tail workloads; projected 6-month payback for pilot scope.
- Talking points for Sara: predictable cost, regional deployment options (US-only), SLA and rollback policy, dedicated support during pilot.
- Technical snippets for Liam/Tom: KV cache behavior, prefix caching to reduce token spend, baseline latency numbers on comparable models.

Proposed internal owners / timeline:
- Champion one-pager (Ben) — draft to Finex by Wed 21 Jul.
- Mutual Action Plan (Evelyn + Ben) — send initial MAP by Wed 21 Jul; request meeting with procurement + Tom for Thu 22 or Fri 23.
- Security artifacts (Karthik) — SOC2 summary and architecture diagram by Mon 26 Jul; full questionnaire answer sheet on a 2-week cadence post-request.

Attachments: champion_onepager.docx, MAP-template.xlsx (will attach first drafts).

If folks agree, Ben and I will send the MAP to Sara and request a 30-min procurement intro + 60-min security workshop.

Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Email: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@finex.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@finex.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Decision path & security gating — next steps for Finex pilot

+1 on the plan. I pushed a first-pass ROI table into the one-pager (high level numbers only). Couple notes:

- Pricing note: I flagged the deal team for a pilot bracket (3-month pilot, capped spend) — if procurement asks for initial numbers, propose $35k–$50k depending on throughput/retention. We can be flexible but want to protect unit economics.
- Deal tracking: adding as FINEX-2027-042 in HubSpot; I'll include the MAP and the one-pager in the deal record.

I'll wait for Karthik's security ETA before proposing firm dates for the security workshop.

Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@finex.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@finex.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@finex.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:00:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Decision path & security gating — security artifacts and timeline

Thanks — quick security scope from my side so Finex knows what to expect:

Required/typical artifacts:
- SOC 2 Type II summary + point of contact (we can share a redacted report).
- Network architecture diagram and data flow (how tokens/requests route, any egress).
- Data retention and deletion policy (docs).
- KMS/HSM approach and key management details.
- Penetration test attestation (if required by procurement).
- Completed security questionnaire (I can turn around a first draft in 3 business days once they share the questionnaire).

ETA:
- SOC2 summary + architecture diagram: by Mon 26 Jul (will attach soc2_summary.pdf and network_diagram.png).
- Full questionnaire answers: draft within 3 business days of receiving their questionnaire.

Notes on constraints: For data residency — we can commit to US-only for the pilot; for long-term enterprise deployments we can discuss dedicated capacity or private (VPC) options.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@finex.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@finex.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procure@finex.com>, Tom Huang <tom.huang@finex.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan + requested next meetings (security workshop & procurement intro)

Liam / Sara / Procurement / Tom —

Thanks for the clarity. Attached is the initial MAP and the champion one-pager (see attachments). Summary of requested next steps so we can keep to the target pilot window:

Action items / owners / target date:
- Finex to confirm security questionnaire owner and send questionnaire to karthik.iyer@redwood.ai — target: Thu 22 Jul.
- Redwood to deliver SOC2 summary and architecture diagram — target: Mon 26 Jul (Karthik).
- Procurement intro (Finex procure@finex.com + Redwood legal/ops) — propose Fri 23 Jul, 11:00 PT (30 min). Please confirm.
- Security workshop (deep dive for Tom + engineering) — propose Mon 26 Jul, 60 min. Karthik to lead.
- Exec alignment: Ben to share ROI one-pager with Sara (Done) and request written confirmation on primary decision criteria (cost, SLA, data residency).

DocuSign link for an initial SOW template (for procurement preview): https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-finex-map
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FINEX-2027-042

If the dates work, Ben and I will calendar the procurement intro and security workshop and include the MAP in the calendar invites.

Thanks — looping Kim for CS onboarding planning once pilot is greenlit.

Best,

Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0199
